limitations: Two actual B8 states, not all16 capture cells and not model E2E.
PAT includes local scheduler and stream compatibility repairs; CUDA arithmetic and partition/tile choices unchanged.
Prepared topology/metadata; one-token truncation stays inside an assigned private CTA. Arbitrary growth/replanning is untested.
Changed-input qualification calls each own eager reference outside measured graph blocks; performance loops use only graph.replay.
CUPTI proves complete graph coverage in the sampled trace, not every timing block. No profiler occupancy/duration performance inference.
Raw candidate here is grouped-hint with original three copy kernels, not the newer direct-input two-launch variant.
No graph-specific memcheck run in this artifact; prior eager fixed-scheduler memchecks passed.
